# FG-CI-0015

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `configured_default_volumes_stop_the_runner_before_any_job` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI の Runner のホストの設定では、ジョブのコンテナを Runner から切り離せません。Runner は起動しませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The CI runner host's settings cannot keep a job's container apart from the runner. The runner did not start. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pengaturan host runner CI tidak dapat memisahkan kontainer tugas dari runner. Runner tidak dijalankan. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

ADR-0029 amendment 2026-11-12: before it claims a job (and in `forge-runner check`) the runner verifies that Podman adds nothing to a job's container that the runner did not ask for. It creates one probe container `forge-isolation-probe-<pid>` like a service (the job's confinement, `--network=none`, no `--volume`), never started, from the empty directory `<work_dir>/runner/empty-rootfs` (`--rootfs`, no image, no pull), reads its mounts with `podman inspect` and removes it. Any mount is a default `volumes` entry of containers.conf (`[containers] volumes = [...]` in /usr/share/containers, /etc/containers, ~/.config/containers or a `containers.conf.d` drop-in): Podman adds it to every container, even next to a job's own `--volume` (and `podman inspect` then hides it), and no flag removes it. The quay.io/podman/stable image ships `volumes = ["/proc:/proc"]` in ~/.config/containers/containers.conf, which gave every job the runner's /proc — every process of the runner, of other jobs and of their services (found on the test runner, 2026-11-12). `reason=default_volumes` with `mounts` (`<type> <destination>`, e.g. `bind /proc`); `reason=probe_failed` with `step` (`create` / `inspect` / `remove`), `exit_code` or `timeout_ms`, and `podman_stderr` when Podman itself failed (the probe could not be made, so isolation is unverified). The PID, IPC, UTS and cgroup namespaces are not checked here: every job container gets `--pid=private --ipc=private --uts=private --cgroupns=private` and a job's pod `--share=net` whatever containers.conf says.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (alert) at start-up with `error_code`, `request_id` and `context` `reason`, `mounts` or `step` / `exit_code` / `podman_stderr`; the runner exits non-zero before claiming any job, so `forge doctor`'s `ci.runners` goes stale and pending jobs wait (FG-CI-0005 after 10 minutes). `forge-runner check` prints the same code. As the runner's user (read-only): `grep -rn volumes /usr/share/containers/containers.conf /etc/containers/containers.conf /etc/containers/containers.conf.d ~/.config/containers/containers.conf ~/.config/containers/containers.conf.d` and `echo $CONTAINERS_CONF $CONTAINERS_CONF_OVERRIDE`.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner (Job isolation): remove the `volumes` entry from the containers.conf that sets it, or add a drop-in for the runner's user `~/.config/containers/containers.conf.d/50-forge-job.conf` with `[containers]` `volumes = []` (the test runner's ops/runner/containers.conf), after human approval; then `forge-runner check` and restart the runner. For `probe_failed`, repair Podman as for FG-CI-0007 (rootless setup, storage).
